svg.title: The integration contract: state, spectators and consensus
svg.desc: A technical depth schematic based on merge 471f7f7. Upstream eea67d1 uses protocol 9 and save-state 11; the four-player branch 4b578bf uses protocol 8 and save-state 11. Their merge uses protocol 10 and save-state 12, with marker-aware MVC legacy section handling. Viewers receive a confirmed snapshot, four independent input words and hashes, and acknowledge their own cursor. SetAgrees requires every playing link to match the target and scores. A subsequent readiness fix preserves readiness only for that exact result and has protocol-test evidence only. Mode events remain queued until required recipients acknowledge them. Buffer cells are schematic, not capacity scales. Four-machine internet testing remains outstanding. A later invitation RPC fix commits match generation before yielding, rereads fresh state, validates generation and lifetime, and merges only the invitation outcome so concurrent admissions survive.

g.aria-label: Versioned state. Isolated viewers. Agreement from every player.
kWatchFrames = 4096; late join starts at its own snapshot.
Viewer ACKs do not advance player confirmation or timing.
Four-player matches retain their mode. Buffer cells show structure, not capacity.
Rehost or expiry: discard a stale reply. A superseded polling request returns 409.
Five new race regressions. 39 Worker tests pass. Gameplay has not been rerun.
